# awscc_licensemanager_license_configuration (Resource)

Resource schema for AWS::LicenseManager::LicenseConfiguration. A license configuration is an abstraction of a customer license agreement that can be consumed and enforced by License Manager.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `license_counting_type` (String) Dimension used to track the license inventory.
- `name` (String) Name of the license configuration.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the license configuration.
- `disassociate_when_not_found` (Boolean) When true, disassociates a resource when software is uninstalled.
- `license_count` (Number) Number of licenses managed by the license configuration.
- `license_count_hard_limit` (Boolean) Indicates whether hard or soft license enforcement is used. Exceeding a hard limit blocks the launch of new instances.
- `license_expiry` (Number) License configuration expiry as an epoch timestamp (seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z).
- `license_rules` (List of String) License rules. The syntax is #name=value (for example, #allowedTenancy=EC2-DedicatedHost).
- `product_information_list` (Attributes List) Product information. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--product_information_list))
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to add to the license configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `license_configuration_arn` (String) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the license configuration.
- `license_configuration_id` (String) Unique ID of the license configuration.
- `owner_account_id` (String) Account ID of the owner of the license configuration.
- `status` (String) License configuration status.

<a id="nestedatt--product_information_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `product_information_list`

Optional:

- `product_information_filter_list` (Attributes List) A product information filter list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--product_information_list--product_information_filter_list))
- `resource_type` (String) Resource type. The possible values are SSM_MANAGED | RDS.

<a id="nestedatt--product_information_list--product_information_filter_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `product_information_list.product_information_filter_list`

Optional:

- `product_information_filter_comparator` (String) Logical operator.
- `product_information_filter_name` (String) Filter name.
- `product_information_filter_value` (List of String) Filter value.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_licensemanager_license_configuration.example
  identity = {
    license_configuration_arn = "license_configuration_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `license_configuration_arn` (String) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the license configuration

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_licensemanager_license_configuration.example
  id = "license_configuration_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
